# Scenario v2 — Authoring Template

Use for interview scenarios in tier markdown (`interview-qa/0*.md`) and scenario bank entries.

```yaml
---
# Within tier question object or scenario bank row
id: <tier>-<nnn>
tier: <A|B|C|D>
topic: <canonical-topic-key>
difficulty: <easy|medium|hard>
---
```

## Think first

What the candidate should clarify or plan before answering (scope, risks, trade-offs).

## Expected answer

Staff-level answer: structure, Playwright-specific hooks, measurable outcomes.

## Why the interviewer asks

Signal being measured (judgment, depth, production awareness).

## Common wrong answer

Typical weak response and why it fails in real teams.

## Real project example

Brief anonymized production anecdote tying the answer to shipped work.

## Follow-ups

2–3 probing follow-up questions an interviewer might ask next.
